scope: Independent bounded legacy member-profile draft dismissal, in-flight save and confirmed-write/readback recovery review for approved plan75. Not whole-plan or all-dialog acceptance.
verified: Initial field defaults and edit-then-revert are clean. Pointer Close and Escape close without a dirty prompt.
Dirty pointer Close and Escape offer explicit discard confirmation. Declining preserves the exact draft and open native modal.
Busy saves prevent pointer Close and Escape dismissal and trigger a beforeunload cancellable event guard.
Confirmed successful comment clears only its own form and preserves an independent unsaved alias draft.
Failed comment mutation preserves its input, and no automatic retry occurs.
Confirmed mutation followed by profile GET503 presents Refresh profile and blocks additional writes. Saved fields are disabled to prevent untracked edits being discarded on readback.
Other form fields remain editable during readback recovery. Newly edited sibling draft survives both failed and successful GET-only retries.
Repeated manual readback retry performs one GET each and never repeats the confirmed POST; intercepted profile contains exactly one corresponding comment.
Accepted discard removes the beforeunload effect; initial ordinary close returns focus to its opener.

Source inspection confirms duplicate open requests use the same cancel/dirty/busy boundary, direct private-dialog removal releases the unload listener, and close avoids stealing deliberate newer focus.

Existing five mutation paths and submitted payload constructions remain intact in inspected source. Independent test verifies the unchanged comment body payload; root separate suite covers other forms.

Final Refresh focus patch independently rechecked in source: current meaningful dialog focus takes precedence over captured fallback. Independent browser rerun asserts failed GET restores Refresh focus and subsequent real Enter activation performs successful GET-only recovery at all3 widths.

resolved_findings.problem: Inputs in an already-confirmed saved form were editable while awaiting failed readback; successful Refresh would reset those new edits.
resolved_findings.resolution: Saved form fieldset disabled until readback completes; independent browser test confirms saved textarea cannot edit while sibling inputs remain editable and preserved.

tests_executed.result: 3 responsive Chromium workflows passed on final focus patch at320/390/1280; real pointer and keyboard including failed readback focus restoration and Enter retry; intercepted requests,0backend writes

remaining_limits: This review does not certify plan75 across every navigation, month-switch and other dialog boundary.
beforeunload behavior was checked by dispatching a cancellable event. Browser-native actual tab-exit confirmation and physical devices were not tested.
Role gating beyond inspected existing conditionals, all five form payload outcomes, account switching and global session recovery require their separate suites.
Unknown mutation outcomes after network failure are not confirmed writes and remain subject to the existing API uncertainty guidance; no automatic mutation reconciliation or retry is claimed.
No backend source or application source changes by reviewer; only independent test/report artifacts added.
